In the original code, a mismatch between `purpose` and `scope.purpose` would cause the branch body to execute (e.g., raising an error, returning early, or logging a violation). With the mutation, that branch body can never execute regardless of the values of `purpose` and `scope.purpose`. Any input where `purpose != scope.purpose` would previously have produced different observable behavior (exception raised, error response, alternative return value) than the mutated version, which silently skips the branch. This is an observable behavioral difference in the governed system.
